name: Enterprise Document, Drawing, Specification & Construction Information Management

domains.name: Document Control
domains.purpose: Controlled creation, numbering, metadata, status, revisions, distribution, retention and supersession.

domains.name: Drawing Management
domains.purpose: Drawing registers, sheets, revisions, disciplines, sets, overlays, markups and issued-for-purpose states.

domains.name: Specification Management
domains.purpose: Specification sections, revisions, addenda, requirements, references and drawing/spec coordination.

domains.name: Submittals
domains.purpose: Submittal packages, items, reviewers, due dates, review cycles, dispositions and closeout.

domains.name: RFIs
domains.purpose: RFI creation, routing, response, impact, linked documents, drawings, cost/schedule effects and closure.

domains.name: Transmittals & Distribution
domains.purpose: Formal issue packages, recipients, acknowledgements, purpose-of-issue and distribution evidence.

domains.name: Correspondence & Records
domains.purpose: Letters, notices, meeting records, emails imported as records, decisions and contractual correspondence.

domains.name: Version & Revision Control
domains.purpose: Immutable revision history, comparison, supersession, rollback, effective versions and audit evidence.

domains.name: Markup & Review
domains.purpose: Collaborative markup, comments, redlines, stamps, review sessions, issue resolution and approval.

domains.name: OCR & Content Extraction
domains.purpose: Text extraction, document classification, metadata proposals, table extraction and searchable indexing.

domains.name: Plan & Spec Intelligence
domains.purpose: AI-assisted plan/spec reading, scope extraction, requirement detection, cross-reference and conflict detection.

domains.name: Document Search & Retrieval
domains.purpose: Full-text, metadata, semantic, sheet, section, project, discipline and permission-aware search.

domains.name: Records Retention & Legal Hold
domains.purpose: Retention schedules, disposition, legal holds, immutable evidence and deletion controls.

domains.name: External Collaboration
domains.purpose: Controlled guest access, consultant/subcontractor review, secure sharing and expiring links.

domains.name: Field Document Access
domains.purpose: Mobile/offline current-set access, QR/location links, acknowledgements and sync controls.

domains.name: BIM/CDE Coordination
domains.purpose: Model/document references, common data environment states, issue links and coordination records.

domains.name: Closeout & Turnover
domains.purpose: As-builts, O&M manuals, warranties, training records, turnover packages and owner acceptance.

domains.name: Document Intelligence Digital Twin
domains.purpose: Current information state across projects, revisions, decisions, relationships and downstream impacts.

critical_governance: One authoritative current revision per controlled information context
Superseded versions remain immutable and traceable
Permissions apply to search, previews, downloads, exports and AI retrieval
AI extraction and Q&A must cite source evidence and revision
AI cannot autonomously issue contractual responses or publish authoritative revisions
